subject: extn
title: EXTN.-----SOC.RT.
description: Second diagram on page 318, paired with the TH-CONT × PER-TRS crossing above it. Where the first diagram structurally shows how the applied-redefinitions hub intercepts thrust-continuance on its way to the partner-side outputs, this one shows the same suppression mechanism at the deeper level the prose names — 'the reality position (and/or affinity dynamics) underlying what a given creative participation really meant in its vibrational and cosmic sense.' The crossing: (C)EXTN (the central reality of existentialism — what alternative creativity actually is, ontologically) crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the receiving culture's organized acceptance). EXTN is subject on the left with the subject-arrow; V-SY (value system) hangs below it as the immediate downward output, and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) anchors the lower-left margin — the same hub from the previous diagram, now positioned as a *subject-side* output rather than a partner-side interceptor. SOC-RT is partner-center; OP-SD rises up-right and PART (participation) sits to its right, with AF-TD on the right margin. INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) descends centrally from SOC-RT and routes to IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) at the bottom-center and VT-ATT (vibrational attitude) at the lower-right, with OBS (observation) at the very bottom as the partner-side's downward terminus. Structural argument: when existentialism-as-such is crossed with social-reality, the partner's downward chain (INDIV-DY → IST-F-AT / VT-ATT → OBS) is exactly the journalism's process — social-reality routes individual-dynamics into *isolated* focus activism (the journalism's 'particulars of a given focus or opinion' the prose names) and into vibrational-attitude that terminates in mere observation. Meanwhile the subject's downward chain stops at APP-RDEF: the existentialism never reaches its own affinity-alignment output because applied-redefinitions catches it first. The diagonal that lets PART (on the partner side) reach back across into the subject's V-SY is the *only* edge that could carry actual creative participation back to a value-system reading — and in the bebop-reception cycle Braxton describes, that diagonal does not get held. Social-reality consumes existentialism as observation; the cosmic-vibrational sense the prose names is structurally unreachable from the partner-side outputs alone.
